fields.description: Sends a digest on this cadence - which period it covers is set by Daily Range below, independent of how often it sends (e.g. a Daily send can still cover last month's numbers, refreshed every day).
fields.label: Send Daily

fields.description: Sends a digest once a week - which period it covers is set by Weekly Range below.

fields.description: Sends a digest once a month - which period it covers is set by Monthly Range below.
fields.label: Send Monthly

fields.description: Every digest this group sends covers exactly these Employees. Time Buffer here is per-employee; Start/End Time per day of week live on the Employee Schedule table below.
fields.label: Employees

fields.description: One row per Employee per day of week - Start Time/End Time that day, or Day Off (excluded from every flag entirely, same as a public holiday - not just a looser threshold). A day/employee combination with no row here falls back to the app-wide default window (06:00-16:00) rather than being skipped.
fields.label: Employee Schedule
